environment: candidate checkout and the assembled pinned xverse-platform target; offline, Python 3.11+; no process, registry, network or filesystem mutation.
expected: Compilation resolves one plan whose body matches the frozen detailed-design shape and ordering, whose digest self-checks, and whose declared content appears verbatim with no evaluation, retrieval, process start or side effect.
intended_use: An experiment author supplies a closed XDL resource set with the admitted neutral experiment Profile and receives exactly one versioned canonical resolved plan carrying the declared system/component/flow identities, seed, parameters, time domains and mappings, intended fault schedule, observer and metric references, artifact references, declared fidelity limitations and the compiler non-readiness statement.
title: Author compiles declared experiment intent into one canonical resolved plan
